name: Farrah Chaichi
occupation: State Representative; intake specialist at Stoel Rives (per Capital Chronicle)

bio.statement: The Oregon Capital Chronicle's 2026 voter guide describes Chaichi as an intake specialist at Stoel Rives who has served in the Oregon House since 2023.
bio.excerpt: Farrah Chaichi, an intake specialist at Stoel Rives, has served in the Oregon House since 2023.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle 2026 voter guide (Democratic primary, House District 35)

bio.statement: In her Oregon Legislature biography, Chaichi says she studied criminal justice and political science at Seattle University.
bio.excerpt: I went to Seattle University where I studied Criminal Justice and Political Science

positions.statement: In a 2022 Ballotpedia candidate survey, Chaichi said housing is a human right (statement dates from her first campaign).
In a 2022 Ballotpedia candidate survey, Chaichi called for a single-payer, Medicare for All style system.
positions.excerpt: We need a single-payer – Medicare for All style – system where everyone is completely covered.

positions.statement: In an August 2026 OPB interview, Chaichi said she would personally like to see solitary confinement abolished and that she has been an advocate for criminal justice reform.
positions.excerpt: I personally would like to see solitary confinement completely abolished

voting_record.statement: OPB reported in January 2026 that Chaichi introduced the Law Enforcement Accountability and Visibility Act, concerning masks worn by law enforcement.
voting_record.excerpt: the Law Enforcement Accountability and Visibility Act, introduced by Rep. Farrah Chaichi, D-Beaverton

voting_record.statement: OPB reported in August 2026 that Chaichi led a lawmakers' letter to the Department of Corrections asking for no more than 15 consecutive days in solitary confinement.
voting_record.excerpt: a number of lawmakers, led by Rep. Farrah Chaichi, send a letter to the Dept. of Corrections
